title: Cause, effect & conclusion
note: B1 Oxford-gap leaf · what follows from what, and how you show it · 12 items · carriers via use[] · schematic intro · Use bank

intro.title: What follows from what
intro.body:
These words do not point at a thing. They point at how one fact leads to another, and at what you can then say about it.
Six are the chain itself: what happens, what follows, what you decide. Six are how you show that you are right.
intro.body_cz: Abstraktní slova — nemají obrázek, protože neukazují na věc, ale na vztah mezi fakty.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: conclude is the verb, conclusion is the noun: we conclude something, and that is our conclusion.

sentences.en: The new law had a big impact on small companies.
sentences.cz: Nový zákon měl velký dopad na malé firmy.
accepts: The new law had a big impact on small companies

sentences.en: Her family had a strong influence on her.
sentences.cz: Její rodina na ni měla silný vliv.
accepts: Her family had a strong influence on her

sentences.en: These problems occur only in winter.
sentences.cz: Tyto problémy nastávají jen v zimě.
accepts: These problems occur only in winter

sentences.en: This job requires a lot of patience.
accepts: This job requires a lot of patience

sentences.en: We came to the same conclusion.
accepts: We came to the same conclusion

sentences.en: From these facts we can conclude that he was right.
sentences.cz: Z těchto faktů můžeme usoudit, že měl pravdu.
accepts: From these facts we can conclude that he was right

sentences.en: The results indicate a serious problem.
accepts: The results indicate a serious problem
The results show a serious problem

sentences.en: It is difficult to define this word.
accepts: It is difficult to define this word
It's difficult to define this word

sentences.en: The doctors could not determine the cause.
accepts: The doctors could not determine the cause
The doctors couldn't determine the cause
